objective: Acquire and byte-verify the official IGVF HCASMC global differential-expression gzip as an opaque binary for a possible future independent panel-response confirmation.

candidate_dependency.required_before_effect_value_access: Experiment 125 candidate must be frozen and hash-addressed
candidate_dependency.consequence: Effect values remain inaccessible. Opaque acquisition is permitted by the user.

permitted_actions: Download and inspect the separate guide-RNA metadata asset IGVFFI9546UECF.
Derive exact target overlap from guide identifiers and the local VCC perturbation list.
Download IGVFFI0206LUDV.tsv.gz as an opaque binary after PRE_DOWNLOAD_FREEZE.v1.json exists.
Measure the compressed object's byte size.
Compute hashes over the raw compressed bytes.
Compare compressed byte size and MD5 against official IGVF metadata.
Record transport headers and an acquisition receipt.
prohibited_actions: Run gzip -t or any command that inflates the effect stream.
Inspect the effect gzip header, TSV header, strings, rows, columns, values, or statistics.
Open the older global differential-expression table or the local differential-expression table.
Define, fit, select, tune, or evaluate a confirmation candidate.
Access DLD1, Pan, H1, Orion held outcomes, cell-eval2, count generation, submission building, or challenge submission.

metadata_only_overlap_rule.target_symbol_derivation: Remove the terminal underscore followed by decimal guide number from guide_id.

stop_conditions: Official source accession, analysis-set membership, status, URL, byte size, or published compressed MD5 cannot be established.
Downloaded compressed byte size differs from 1531381676.
Any tool would require decompression or tabular parsing of IGVFFI0206LUDV.tsv.gz.
future_access_rule: A future value-access authorization must be a new permanent file that names and hashes the frozen Experiment 125 candidate, this protocol, PRE_DOWNLOAD_FREEZE.v1.json, VALUE_ACCESS_BOUNDARY.v1.json, SOURCE_MANIFEST.expected.v1.json, and ACQUISITION_RECEIPT.v1.json. This acquisition protocol must never be edited to grant access.
